intro: Our Neofeel mattress keeps you cool and cradled till morning. Designed for uninterrupted sleep, it contours to your body while staying breathable—so you wake up refreshed and recharged.

features.title: Foam that hugs and supports you gently
features.text: Let your mattress work for you! It contours to your body shape, easing pressure points and ensuring you drift into restful, uninterrupted sleep.

features.title: Anti-slip base keeps things in place
features.text: No more slipping and sliding—this textured base keeps your mattress firmly in place, even on smooth surfaces, so you can rest undisturbed.

features.title: Breathable fabric keeps you cool
features.text: Breathe easy and sleep cool—the pre-quilted fabric lets air flow freely, keeping you fresh and comfortable through the night.

features.title: Soft foam layer that pampers you
features.text: Sink into comfort as the plush PU foam gently hugs your body, offering a soothing, cushioned feel that makes every night a luxurious escape.

features.title: Designed to fit any room with ease
features.text: Available in a range of sizes, our design adapts effortlessly to your bed frame, so you can create a sleep space that’s perfectly suited to your style and needs.

name: Neofeel King Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 72 X 6 Inches
